title: Lawrence Bell's 1956 article quote on working with nuclear fuels to cancel gravity
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lawrence Bell's 1956 article quote on working with nuclear fuels to cancel gravity, about 1956 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's an article in 1956 where they're saying we're going to beat gravity and it's right around the bend and Lawrence Bell's quote from this article is we are already working with nuclear fuels to cancel out gravity

related.note: Same 1956 article and the same quote about working with nuclear fuels to cancel out gravity, but the story gives it to George Trimble and this telling gives it to Lawrence Bell.
